messages:
From: Helen Murray <helen.murray@novahealth.com>

Cc: Daniel Cho <dcho@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form + on-prem annex - license boundary and audit window

Evelyn —

Thanks for the demo last week. We shared the draft MSA + Order Form with legal and they returned a couple of requests specific to our on-prem / VPC deployment needs:

- Narrow the license territory to only Nova Health production clusters (we proposed a ‘license geofence’ clause).
- Define an audit window and scope for evidence access (limited timeframe, read-only access, and witness options).
- Clarify rollback / snapshot handover in a way that doesn’t require wholesale code escrow (we want a mechanism for operator witness and a signed snapshot receipt).

I attached our redlines for the MSA and a proposed annex for the Order Form. Can Redwood confirm whether these map to existing private-deploy exhibits (operator access, witnessing, limited forensic snapshot)? If not, we’ll need firm language added to the Order Form annex.

Also: we have an upcoming vendor review on 6/25; would appreciate an indication of how long Redwood legal needs to review and whether you expect any material objections.

Thanks,
Helen Murray
Director, Platform Security
Nova Health

Helen — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Looping in Laura (legal) and Aditya (product/security) to get a coordinated response. Quick notes while we pull docs: 

- We can scope the license to specific clusters/production tenancy ("license geofence") but need a short definition to avoid ambiguity (suggest we map to Nova Health account IDs + region list).
- For audits, Redwood supports a scoped, time-boxed read-only witness with an agreed checklist. Our usual approach is: 2 business-days notice, up to 8 hours of assisted witness access, and a snapshot + signed receipt. We can propose language that stops short of full escrow.
- For rollback/snapshot handover, product prefers an operator-witness model or custodial snapshot delivery to an agreed secure bucket, with HMAC evidence and an access log.

Laura — would you be able to review the attached redlines and suggest edits to the Order Form annex? Aditya, please advise on whether the geofence/account-ID mapping is operationally reasonable and whether we need a small fee for witness runs.

I’ll aim to get back to Helen with proposed wording and a timeline for Legal by EOD Monday (6/21).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Evelyn —

Appreciate the quick reply. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Account IDs: Nova will provide a list of three production account IDs (two US regions + one DR). We need the license language to explicitly name those IDs or reference an Exhibit A that we can update by mutual agreement.
- Audit logistics: the vendor review is internal and low-risk; we want to avoid escalation to full third-party review. A 2-business-day notice plus a single 4-hour witness window would be sufficient for now. If evidence requires additional time, we can negotiate per-event.
- Fees: we don't expect a large fee for the witness run but will accept a nominal admin charge if it expedites scheduling.

We attached a short annotated version of our redline focusing on the Account ID clause and a suggested Exhibit A statement. Can Redwood produce a proposed annex that mirrors that approach?

Thanks,
Daniel Cho
Senior Counsel, Vendor Risk
Nova Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Helen Murray <helen.murray@novahealth.com>, Daniel Cho <dcho@novahealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form + on-prem annex - license boundary and audit window

Hi Helen / Daniel —

Thanks for the annotated redlines. Attached is a first-pass Annex A (Order Form exhibit) and a short MSA paragraph we propose to insert under "Deployment & Evidence". Highlights: 

1) License Geofence: We reference Account IDs explicitly and include an "Exhibit A - Licensed Environments" placeholder. Exhibit A can be amended by mutual written agreement (we included a one-sentence amendment path).

2) Audit / Witnessing: Proposed text limits audits to read-only, time-boxed witness runs (2 business days' notice, single event up to 8 hours by default; additional time requires mutual consent). We added a clause on HMAC-signed snapshot receipts and an obligation on Redwood to provide sanitized logs (redact PII) where applicable.

3) Snapshot Handover: The annex allows a custodial snapshot transfer to a customer-controlled secure bucket with mutually-agreed KMS key policy for decryption and a signed receipt; we deliberately avoided escrow terminology but preserved a clear chain-of-custody.

4) Fees & Scheduling: Admin fee language is optional — we included a nominal admin fee placeholder and a clause that Redwood will waive the fee for initial onboarding witness runs during the first contracted year.

If this aligns, we can convert the annex into tracked changes for your counsel to review and then circulate a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form update. If any of this materially changes Nova's commercial expectations, flag it and we’ll escalate internally.

Attachments: AnnexA_OrderForm_LicensedEnvs.pdf (proposed wording), MSA_Deployment_paragraph_redline.docx

Next steps I suggest:
- Nova confirms Exhibit A account IDs (we'll add as an attachment).
- You circulate comments on the proposed annex by 6/22 to hit your 6/25 vendor review.
- If agreed, we'll issue a DocuSign link for the Order Form addendum + updated Order Form.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
